verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents Batch Sending: one request lists multiple recipients as `to` parameters and uses Recipient Variables for per-recipient personalization, so the single-request personalized batch is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows the response returning per-message or per-recipient status. Missing for 10: per-message status in the batch response, in-depth API reference for batch limits and response format, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a batch of personalized emails in a single API request with per-message status in the response, instead of looping one call per recipient

citations.quote: Using Batch Sending by specifying multiple recipient email addresses as to parameters and using Recipient Variables.
